title: Electromotive Force
description: Essential: The student must correctly identify the EMF as the y-intercept (U when I=0) from the power supply's U-I line, obtaining 4 V.

title: Internal Resistance
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the internal resistance from the negative slope of the power supply's U-I line, obtaining 1 Ω.

title: Operating Point
description: Essential: The student must correctly identify the intersection point of the two U-I lines as the circuit's operating point.

title: Terminal Voltage
description: Essential: The student must correctly read the terminal voltage as the U-coordinate of the intersection point, obtaining 3 V.

title: Output Power
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the output power using P = UI with the coordinates from the intersection point, obtaining 3 W.

title: Graph Interpretation
description: Optional: The student demonstrates correct interpretation of both U-I lines, distinguishing the power supply line from the resistor line.

title: Sign/Unit Errors
description: Pitfall: The student makes a sign error in calculating internal resistance or omits units in final answers.

title: Operating Current
description: Important: The student must correctly read the operating current as the I-coordinate of the intersection point, obtaining 1 A.
